The presence of forged invoices suggests also "伪造发票". In examples, they used that label for forged documents. So include both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
